text:
alex: FYI, discovered that a staging ingest task logged plaintext emails for ~10-20m. I stopped the job and rotated the deploy creds.

jamie (oncall): Which log prefix? I'll isolate and quarantine the objects.

alex: s3://redwood-staging/logs/ingest/2026-03-02/*worker*.log

maria (sec): Don't paste real PII in thread. If you need to show pattern, mask it. Also pause any external log forwarders.

alex: masked sample:
```
[...timestamp...] INFO user_id=999 user_email=alice@example.com action=ingest
```
(edited) that was real in the files, removed local copies.

jamie (oncall): Actions: 1) suspend forwarder 2) copy to quarantine bucket s3://redwood-quarantine/staging-2026-03-02/ 3) run scrub script 4) run CloudTrail audit for GET/Copy events

incident-bot: keys rotated by alex at 2026-03-02T09:12:00Z. S3 object ACLs changed.

sudha (legal): Need scope: number of unique emails and whether data left our AWS account. If it did, we may have disclosure obligations.

maria (sec): Initial tally ~310 unique emails in affected files. No evidence yet of third-party access; checking S3 access logs and ELB logs.

lee (product): If only staging and internal, probably no customer notice. @sudha can confirm threshold.

sudha (legal): If no external exposure, no mandatory customer notice. We will want an internal incident summary and a remediation plan.

alex: I already opened GH PR for a scrub lambda that filters `user_email` before write. Will link it here.

jamie (oncall): I kicked off scrubbing: `scripts/scrub-logs --replace 'user_email=[^\s]+' 'user_email=<REDACTED>'` quarantined objects replaced; set bucket to private. Added CloudTrail report to wiki.

maria (sec): Please paste exact S3 keys that were affected.

alex: keys:
- s3://redwood-staging/logs/ingest/2026-03-02/worker-a.log
- s3://redwood-staging/logs/ingest/2026-03-02/worker-b.log
- s3://redwood-staging/logs/ingest/2026-03-02/worker-c.log

jamie (oncall): Those are moved to quarantine. ACLs removed, lifecycle to never public. Audit shows only alex and jamie accessed them during triage.

maria (sec): Uploading incident scope doc to confluence: /confluence/incidents/INC-2026-032. It includes timeline, affected objects, counts, and actions. Tagging legal for review.

sudha (legal): Reviewed scope. No external access found. Legal clears no external notification. Approve internal comms with minimal details.

lee (product): I'll send internal note to ops+support after sec posts final timeline. Keep messaging that "no production customer data exposed".

maria (sec): Follow-up ticket created to enforce auto-scrub in staging and add a pre-write filter. Also recommending retention policy change for staging logs.

alex: Thanks all. Will merge PR and deploy scrub lambda behind feature flag today. Lessons learned: avoid logging raw emails in handlers.

jamie (oncall): Closing the thread on our end. If you see any related alerts tag eng-security.

maria (sec): Closing incident after final verification. :white_check_mark:
